oson-uy.description: A platform for the property market: a catalogue of residential complexes and apartment search by parameter.
overview: Oson Uy is a platform where property developers list their residential complexes and buyers find apartments by parameter. SDS is responsible for the whole product: the storefront, the catalogue, the search and the developer's workspace.
challenge: A buyer needs to compare apartments on concrete parameters — region, district, price per square metre and area. A developer needs to manage their own catalogue and see incoming enquiries. Both have to work inside one system, or the data on the storefront quickly drifts from reality.
solution: We built the platform as two connected halves: a public storefront with the catalogue and search, and a developer's workspace holding projects, floors, prices and enquiries. They share the same data, so a change in the workspace is immediately visible to the buyer.
features: Search by region, district, price per m² and area
result: The platform is live and still being developed. Three products have grown around it: the storefront, the mobile app and the CRM.

captions.home: The home page and the housing search

oson-uy-mobile.description: The mobile app of the Oson Uy platform.

oson-uy-crm.description: The developer's workspace: enquiries, projects, floors, prices and plans in one panel.
overview: The management side of the Oson Uy platform. A developer runs their projects, tracks buyer enquiries and manages the data buyers see on the storefront.
challenge: Selling new-build apartments rests on two things: how quickly enquiries are handled, and how current the listing data is. While both live in spreadsheets and chat threads, a developer has no overall picture.
solution: We built a workspace where enquiries, projects, floors, prices per square metre and plans all sit in one place. On opening it, a developer sees a summary of their activity and the most recent enquiries.
features: Projects, floors and prices per m²
An activity summary for the workspace
result: The public catalogue and the developer's own data live in one system — whatever changes in the workspace is immediately available to buyers.

captions.overview: The workspace summary and recent enquiries. Personal data is redacted.
